data.name: ContributionModeLabel
data.comment: Field label on the Metaverse attribute editor.

data.name: ContributionModePriority
data.comment: A contribution mode: the highest-priority contributor supplies the values.

data.name: ContributionModeAccumulate
data.comment: A contribution mode: every contributor adds values, and none is removed. An imperative verb, as a mode name.

data.name: ContributionModeHelper
data.value: How the values of several Synchronisation Rules are combined. Priority takes them from the highest-priority contributor; Accumulate adds every value and never removes one through synchronisation.
data.comment: Helper text under the Contribution Mode field. Priority and Accumulate are the mode names (ContributionModePriority, ContributionModeAccumulate).

data.name: ContributionModeReferenceHelper
data.value: Accumulate is not available for a Reference attribute, because a reference is removed with the Metaverse Object it points to. To keep a history of references, record them as text in a separate attribute.
data.comment: Helper text under the Contribution Mode field when the attribute is a Reference attribute.

data.name: AccumulateNotice
data.value: From each Metaverse Object's next synchronisation, every contributor adds its values to this attribute, and synchronisation never removes one, even after the account that supplied it is deleted.
data.comment: Notice shown when an administrator changes an attribute to Accumulate, before saving.

data.name: LeaveAccumulateNotice
data.value: At each Metaverse Object's next synchronisation, the values this attribute kept that no contributor supplies any more are removed, and exports remove them from target systems.
data.comment: Warning shown when an administrator changes an attribute from Accumulate to another mode, before saving.

data.name: LeaveAccumulateDialogTitle
data.comment: Title of the confirmation dialog. {0} is the attribute's name.

data.name: LeaveAccumulateWarning
data.value: Changing '{0}' to Priority removes, at each Metaverse Object's next synchronisation, the values that no contributor supplies any more, and exports then remove them from target systems. They cannot be recovered.
data.comment: Body of the confirmation dialog. {0} is the attribute's name; Priority is the mode name.

data.name: PriorityListAccumulateNotice
data.value: This attribute uses the Accumulate contribution mode: every Synchronisation Rule below adds its values and none is preferred, so there is no order to set, and "Null is a value" has no effect.
data.comment: Shown above an Accumulate attribute's contributors, where a Priority attribute shows its priority order. "Null is a value" is a setting's name.

data.name: PendingContributorThisMapping
data.comment: Stands in the Synchronisation Rule column for the mapping being created, which has no rule row yet.

data.name: NullIsValueAccumulateTooltip
data.value: "Null is a value" has no effect on an Accumulate attribute: every contributor adds its values, so there is no winner for a missing value to override.
data.comment: Tooltip on the disabled "Null is a value" switch in the Attribute Flow editor.

data.name: ExportAccumulateAdvisory
data.value: This Metaverse attribute accumulates values, so this Attribute Flow exports every value it has kept, including those from accounts that have since been deleted.
data.comment: Advisory in the Attribute Flow editor when an outbound flow's source attribute uses the Accumulate mode.
